annotations.title: Read one function, or a file outline

description: Read code without opening whole files. With `symbol`: just that function, method or class (numbered lines). Without: the file's outline (every declaration with its signature and line range). Use instead of reading a full file.

repository.description: Public GitHub repository as "owner/name" (e.g. "pallets/flask") or its github.com URL.

symbol.description: Function, method or class name, e.g. "refresh" or "AuthController.refresh".

name: read_code
